1.0.64: Every request now has a deadline: 15 seconds for a question, 5 minutes for an upload, and then it says the connection failed instead of spinning forever.
1.0.65: Crushes now shows what Crushly is posting, not just the people you have added up with — and a new post reaches the feed without a restart.
1.0.66: Crushes now shows everything Crushly publishes, and Notifications only speaks about people: add ups, Keep Closes, Crushes, comments and mentions — never a private Whisper.
1.0.67: Adding up is a request now. Send one and it waits for an answer; when somebody adds up with you, accept or decline it right there — and you can take back a request you have not had an answer to.
1.0.68: Whisper is live. Messages arrive as they are sent, you can see when someone is typing or recording a voice note, and every Whisper you send now tells you whether it was sent, delivered or read.
1.0.69: Video notes are ten seconds and round. A Moment opens only from the ring around the picture, a Moment you have already watched now looks watched, and Top Crushes This Week only shows clips people actually crushed.
1.0.70: A gold ring now sits around somebody else’s picture and never around your own, and your Space shows only what you actually post.
1.0.71: A Space has one Add up, under the name, with Whisper beside it — the footer bar that covered the last post is gone, and Share lives in the three dots.
1.0.72: Signing up now tells you the truth about the email: the code signs you in on your phone, the link confirms you in a browser, and if a code never came, sign-in sends a fresh one.
1.0.73: One clip plays at a time — the one you are looking at — and that is the preview; everything else waits its turn, which is what stops the feed from wading.
1.0.74: Clips play again in the Crushes feed and the Flow viewer — the file was being asked for without the key that unlocks it — and a new build now installs from inside the app instead of sending you back to the browser for 95 MB.
1.0.75: A clip is the card in Crushes now — the picture fills it, the person and their words sit on it, and only Crush and comment cover the frame — and in the Flow viewer the rail and the caption sit lower, so the video has the middle of the screen to itself.
1.0.76: Your Space now looks like a Space: the cover is the picture itself with a softened copy of it behind, the Crushes tab is a wall of tall tiles you pick from instead of a feed, every tab on the page stays on the screen and tappable, and tapping a face opens the picture — or the Moments behind it, with a choice once you have seen both.
1.0.77: Every sheet now has a close button in the corner, so the Create Circle sheet — and every other one — can be put away with one tap instead of a swipe or the back key.
1.0.78: Typing your password no longer sends you to the reset screen by accident, and a Space opens with its cover as a band across the top — picture, name, Add up and all four tabs on one screen instead of a photograph and nothing else.
1.0.79: Circles on your Space use compact Android controls, the Flow player keeps the whole frame in view, and the feed starts preparing nearby photos sooner while doing less work for paused clips.
1.0.80: Advanced options now opens, and you can choose whether people may comment on a new post. The editor no longer offers a fake scheduling switch or silently drops additional media.
1.0.81: When a media upload cannot be completed, Crushly keeps your draft and reports the upload error instead of publishing a file it cannot display.
1.0.82: Crushly checks Android update downloads before opening the installer and no longer reports an update as installed when Android has not confirmed it. Optional update prompts can now be dismissed.
1.0.83: Crushly is now holUpp. On Android, save posts and Moments as drafts stored on this phone, then reopen them from the composer.
1.0.84: The app is called holUpp. Your phone-only Post and Moment drafts stay on your device.
1.0.85: The holUpp launch screen now shows the right name. Android Settings offers Update holUpp only when a newer version is available.
1.0.86: Add a separate Space banner, explore more search categories with filters, and enjoy a holUpp-styled text comment sheet.
1.0.87: Spaces without banners now have a plain background. Bios and links are easier to use, and you can share a Space from its menu.
1.0.88: Add a place name to a post without sharing your device coordinates. Only people who can see the post can see its location.
1.0.89: Open the original Moment from a Whisper reply when it is still available to you.
1.0.90: Find activity in a full-screen notification center, including private Whisper signals, and open the exact Moment from a reply.
1.0.91: Review reports, search accounts, and check admin activity; find your notifications in one full-screen place.
1.0.92: See real Add Up and Kept Close counts on Spaces and choose who can see your Add Ups.
1.0.93: Spaces keep the same banner height, show post likes and offer app navigation. holUpp admin has a dashboard with real activity totals.
1.0.94: Spaces show approved Close Ones counts with privacy controls. Verification is temporarily paused while admin review is prepared.
1.0.95: The app is holUpp everywhere now, and a saved clip carries the new mark and end card.
1.0.98: Deleting is now permanent, everywhere. A deleted post or Moment takes its photo or clip with it — the file is removed from storage, not hidden, so it can never be fetched again and the space comes back. Whispers are photos and voice notes only, two photos a day, and the editor has six real knobs (brightness, warmth, tint, fade, vignette, grain) plus a crop you can place.
1.0.99: Delete is in the Whisper menu now, and it is real: the message leaves the server and so does its photo, for both of you. No video note anywhere in a chat. Updates work again — the app checks, tells you, and installs the new build instead of sitting silently on an old one. The splash says holUpp.
